evals.prompt: Build a presentation interior from a 6x4x2.7 m plan; keep its CAD reference and deliver a camera plate plus editable source.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Checks two dimensions and units before construction.
Uses camera/lens decisions without misrepresenting room size.
Separates glass/frames and returns current image evidence.

evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Returns read-only camera and reflection diagnosis.
